requests.text: Give 10 % off the nights for stays of 7 nights or more.
Charge the city tax: 3 EUR per guest per night.
Hosts keep the whole cleaning fee: take no commission on it.

asks: Host answer: nothing to add, build it as written: 10 % off the nights for stays of 7 nights or more.
7 nights counts (nights >= 7). The discount covers all nights (nights x nightlyRate), not the cleaning fee, not the city tax.
Export function longStayNights(nights, nightlyRate) with no side effects; whole-number maths only, no rounding, no Math.round.
Return the nights amount in hundredths of EUR: nights*nightlyRate*100, or nights*nightlyRate*90 when nights >= 7.
Nights are check-out minus check-in; the check-out day is not a night (why/nights.md). The caller passes nights; do not recompute.
Runs first of the three rules; its result is commissionable. Touch only rules/r1.mjs.
Host answers: "Charge it for the first 7 nights of a stay at most."
"Pay the tax out with the host's payout, as part of the stay: take the commission on it too."
"Only for bookings made on or after 16 November 2026."
City tax is 3 EUR per guest per night.
Export function cityTax(nights, guests, bookedAt) with no side effects; bookedAt is a YYYY-MM-DD string, guests a whole number.
Return whole EUR: 3 * guests * Math.min(nights, 7) when bookedAt >= '2026-11-16' (that day counts), else 0. No rounding, no discount.
Nights are check-out minus check-in; the check-out day is not a night (why/nights.md). The caller passes nights.
The tax is commissionable; the caller adds it to the discounted nights. Touch only rules/r2.mjs.
Host answer: nothing to add, build it as written: hosts keep the whole cleaning fee, no commission on it.
Export function cleaningFeeKept(cleaningFee) with no side effects; cleaningFee is whole EUR.
Return the cleaning fee in whole EUR unchanged; the caller adds it after the commission, never inside the commissionable amount.
Do not read or copy the commission rate; it comes from the course settings in the batch. Touch only rules/r3.mjs.
In judge, import longStayNights (rules/r1.mjs), cityTax (rules/r2.mjs), cleaningFeeKept (rules/r3.mjs). Keep nights = check-out minus check-in; keep the commission argument from settings.
Order: nightsH = longStayNights(nights, rate) (hundredths); taxH = cityTax(nights, day.guests, day.bookedAt)*100; feeEur = cleaningFeeKept(cleaningFee).
Host total = Math.floor(((nightsH + taxH) * (100 - commissionPct) + feeEur * 10000) / 10000). Whole-number maths, one Math.floor at the end (why/payout-rounding.md).
Commission applies to discounted nights plus tax, never to the cleaning fee. Discount not on tax or fee.
Set stayTotal to the stay's booked total in whole EUR: floor((nightsH + taxH)/100) + cleaningFee.
Add 'day' to known.top. Add known day fields guests and bookedAt, so other day keys still count as extra fields and flag.
Flag the task when day is missing, guests is not a whole number >= 0, or bookedAt is not a plain YYYY-MM-DD date (use isDate).
batch.mjs and parked.mjs need no change: they call judge and use total and stayTotal. Update ROLE.md only if it describes the old formula.
